keyEvents.text: Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Borussia M'gladbach 0. Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tidiam Gomis.
First Half ends, RB Leipzig 1, Borussia M'gladbach 0.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Borussia M'gladbach 0. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Tidiam Gomis.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Isac Lidberg replaces Robin Hack.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Franck Honorat replaces Kevin Stöger.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Mathieu Nguefack replaces Lukas Ullrich.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. David Herold replaces Wael Mohya.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christopher Nkunku replaces Tidiam Gomis.
Goal! RB Leipzig 3, Borussia M'gladbach 0. Rocco Reitz (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Christopher Nkunku.
Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Daiki Hashioka (Borussia M'gladbach).
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Johan Bakayoko replaces Brajan Gruda.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Benjamin Henrichs replaces Ridle Baku.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Joe Scally replaces Daiki Hashioka because of an injury.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Arthur Vermeeren replaces Rocco Reitz.
